title: The term, again
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Monday. The fall term. The instructor's Composition II, a third time. She hands the auditor a blue book and says write something in it this year. He draws in it. She says that counts. She's changed the rule; she doesn't say so.

panels.composition: The classroom, fall. The INSTRUCTOR handing out blue books. One to WOOD, at the back.

balloons.text: Write something in it this year, Mr. Finch.

image.prompt: a woman instructor handing a blue exam booklet to a young man at the back of a classroom, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The blue book open. Wood's pen. A drawing: the classroom, again, everyone in it. Ninety seconds.

image.prompt: close on a blue exam booklet with an ink drawing of a classroom inside it, black and white, no words
a woman instructor glancing down at a drawing in a blue booklet as she passes, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood looking up. She's changed the rule. She doesn't say so. He draws her saying nothing. That counts too.

image.prompt: a young man looking up from a booklet at an instructor who has walked on, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox
